paragraphs: I'm a software engineer with a strong passion for machine learning, deep learning and neural networks.
I build systems that learn: from data pipelines to model architectures, from experiments to production code.
This site collects my work and keeps it in one place — experiments, projects and everything in between.

quality.title: My Definition of Quality
quality.intro: I love my job, I put quality of software on top on my priority.
paragraphs: I believe that to build a great product, engineers must have their professional compass oriented toward to the end user's joy, whether is a developer or a final customer, it doesn't matter, the most important thing is to has as a direction the satisfaction of the end user.

I love programming, but i found joy in writing tech spec, this allow to me think at the full picture of how various complex components interacts together, and this improves the quality of my final result.
